description: Checks whether a public GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket repository will deploy: the services it found, what's missing (each with its fix), the environment variables it needs, and what it would cost a month on DigitalOcean, AWS, Google Cloud and Azure. Reads the code and changes nothing. No API key needed. A check can take up to a minute; if it's still running, call again with the check_id it returned.

check_id.description: The check_id of an earlier check, to get its result

name: check_repo
title: Check a repository
